title: Norms & Distances
motto: Your distance function defines what "similar" means. Choose wrong and everything downstream breaks.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Your distance function defines what "similar" means. Choose wrong and everything downstream breaks.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: You have two vectors. Maybe they are word embeddings. Maybe they are user profiles. Maybe they are pixel arrays. You need to know: how close are they?

The answer depends entirely on which distance function you pick. Two data points can be nearest neighbors under one metric and far apart under another. Your KNN classifier, your recommendation engine, your vector database, your clustering algorithm, your loss function -- they all depend on this choice. Get it wrong and your model optimizes for the wrong thing.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: L2 distance powers kNN and embeddings. L1 is robust to outliers. Cosine measures angle, not magnitude.
